==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|deposite}} {{qualifier|17th-19th centuries}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=put down|:lbor|la:depositus<id:put down>|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*tḱey-}}
{{lbor|en|la|depositus}}, past participle of {{m|la|depono||put down}}. {{doublet|en|depot}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/dɪˈpɒz.ɪt/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/dɪˈpɑ.zɪt/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-deposit.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɒzɪt|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|geological layer}}{{lb|en|geology}} Sediment or rock that is not native to its present location or is different from the surrounding material. Sometimes refers to [[ore]] or [[gem]]s.
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1963
|first=Yuan-li
|last=Wu
|chapter=The Infant Petroleum Industry
|title=Economic Development and the Use of Energy Resources in Communist China
|url=https://archive.org/details/economicdevelopm0000wuyu/
|publisher=w:Frederick A. Praeger
|LCCN=63-15122
|OCLC=1041285856
|page=178
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/economicdevelopm0000wuyu/page/178/
|text=Newly discovered oil and gas '''deposits''' at Nan-ch'ung in Szechwan also promise to be of increasing importance.}}
# {{lb|en|law}} [[bailment|Bailment]] of [[personal property]] to be kept gratuitously for the bailor ([[depositor]]) and without any benefit to the bailee ([[depositary]]), e.g. for [[storage]], [[carriage]], [[repair]], etc.
# {{lb|en|banking}} Money placed in a bank account, as for safekeeping or to earn interest.
#: {{co|en|make a '''deposit''' (put money in an account)}}
# Anything left behind on a surface.
#: {{co|en|a mineral '''deposit'''}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''deposit''' of seaweed on the shore}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''deposit''' of jam on my countertop}}
# {{lb|en|finance}} A sum of money or other asset given as an initial payment, to show good faith, or to reserve something for purchase.
#: {{syn|en|earnest money|down payment}}
#: {{ux|en|They put down a '''deposit''' on the apartment.}}
# A sum of money given as a security for a borrowed item, which will be given back when the item is returned, e.g., a [[bottle deposit]] or [[can deposit]]
# A place of deposit; a [[depository]].

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To lay down; to place; to put.
#: {{ux|en|A crocodile '''deposits''' her eggs in the sand.}}
#: {{ux|en|The waters '''deposited''' a rich alluvium.}}
#* {{RQ:Taylor Ductor Dubitantium|passage=This fear is '''deposited''' in conscience.}}
# To lay up or away for safekeeping; to put up; to store.
#: {{syn|en|reposit#Verb}}
#: {{ux|en|to '''deposit''' goods in a warehouse}}
# To entrust one's [[asset]]s to the care of another. Sometimes done as [[collateral]].
# {{senseid|en|money}} {{lb|en|transitive}} To put money or funds into an account.
#: {{syn|en|bank}}
#: {{ux|en|I had to '''deposit''' two months' rent into my landlord's account before he gave me the keys.}}
# To lay aside; to rid oneself of.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1654|author=w:Henry Hammond|title=Of Schism: or a Defence of the Church of England
|passage=reform and '''deposit''' his error}}
